variable.name: LumenSkinSettingHelp
variable.value: In kids mode only the kids' titles play: films and shows tagged in the Cinémathèque app, and the files it lists that Kodi's library doesn't have (it sends this TV where its list is). Any other video started on this TV stops.

Kids mode shows only the titles chosen in the Cinémathèque app. Its kids PIN is the parents' code from the app, which sends it to this TV: the Kids button shows on Home once it's set, and leaving kids mode asks for it.
Shows or hides this row on Home.[CR][CR]Kids mode keeps its own rows.
Adds a row at the end of Home from a smart playlist you pick, then asks for its name. Up to three.[CR][CR]Not shown in kids mode.
Changes the row's name on Home.
Takes the row off Home. The playlist itself stays.
Opens Kodi's video playlists. Choose "New smart playlist…", pick Movies or TV shows and the rules (for example Genre is Documentary), then save it and add it here.

In an episode's last seconds, a card shows the show's next episode, which starts once this one ends. Play now skips the rest; Back hides the card.[CR][CR]When the Cinémathèque app has the next step (its Up next, stop after this, bedtime), the card shows what the app will play and starts nothing.
Slowly zooms the backdrop on Home, library and detail pages.[CR][CR]Looks great, but the whole screen redraws every frame: on a Raspberry Pi menus drop to about half the frame rate. Off by default.
